test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Beside doing the laundry, / Rakesh helped her / in cooking also / when she was ill.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Beside doing the laundry****'**, i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of the preposition 'beside'.
 
• **Beside**, **without the s**, tells us the **location of something**.** Besides**, on the other hand, means **“in addition,” “in addition to,” “moreover,” or “as well,”** depending on context.** **
 
• Example: 
 
 
• Kaia and Rhea sit beside each other in the orchestra’s first violin section.
 
• I dislike fishing; besides, I don’t even own a boat.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, 'besides' will be used in place of 'beside'.

Correct sentence:__ ***Besides** doing the laundry, Rakesh helped her in cooking also when she was ill.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 
• Preposition: a word governing, and usually preceding, a noun or pronoun and expressing a relation to another word or element in the clause.
